sources.title: Hy3 official model card, pinned revision
sources.evidence: Exact Hy3 instruct release: nominal 295B total, 21B active, separately listed 3.8B MTP layer, MoE, 80 non-MTP layers, GQA, 192 routed experts and top-8 routing. Distinguishes Hy3 from its preview and FP8 variant; supplies deployment and reasoning examples.

sources.title: Hy3 checkpoint configuration, pinned revision
sources.evidence: HYV3ForCausalLM/hy_v3; max_position_embeddings 262144, 80 layers, 192 experts with eight selected per token and one shared expert, 64 query/eight KV heads, one next-token-prediction layer, BF16 dtype, untied token embeddings.

sources.title: Hy3 weight license, pinned revision
sources.evidence: The file explicitly licenses Tencent Hy3 under Apache-2.0 and includes the Apache License 2.0 terms.

sources.title: Tencent Hunyuan Officially Releases Hy3, Advancing Agent Capabilities and Deeper Product Integration
sources.evidence: Dated July 6, 2026: officially launched Hy3; API now available on TokenHub; worldwide downloadable Apache-2.0 weights available from day one on Hugging Face and ModelScope. Calls this release distinct from Hy3 preview and says Tencent Hunyuan is now Tencent Hy.

sources.title: Hy3 official chat template, pinned revision
sources.evidence: Processes text message content; supports reasoning_effort no_think/low/high and reasoning content; serializes tool definitions, assistant function calls, arguments and tool responses.

sources.title: TokenHub model list
sources.evidence: Documentation updated October 26, 2026 lists hy3 separately from hy4-preview and retired hy3-preview; Hy3 supports deep reasoning, structured output and Function Calling, with 256k service context, 192k input and 128k output.

sources.title: Hy3 repository metadata
sources.evidence: Accessed current main revision a960ebc3da325ba167f069f76c41eb62c9280d22 (last modified July 20); repository created July 2. Creation/modification timestamps are not used as public release dates. Aggregate safetensors metadata was inspected but is not accepted as an exact learned-parameter count.

sources.title: Hy4 preview official model card, later sibling check
sources.evidence: Later sibling explicitly has 770B backbone/49B active and its own MTP and Gated DSA architecture; these specifications do not belong to Hy3. No replacement exact Hy3 parameter disclosure was identified here.

name.note: Exact stable instruct release; not Hy3-preview, Hy3-FP8 or Hy4-preview.

developer.note: Developed by the Tencent Hy Team.

family.note: Tencent names the model family Tencent Hy, formerly Tencent Hunyuan.

release_date.note: The dated developer announcement explicitly establishes public API and downloadable-weight availability. July 2 repository creation and July 20 configuration revision are not release evidence.

open_weights.note: Tencent explicitly makes Hy3 weights downloadable; the official model card links the BF16 instruct checkpoint.

license.note: Exact Hy3 license, not the earlier preview license.

parameters_b.note: Publisher nominal count in billions, not an exact tensor sum. The model card separately lists 3.8B MTP parameters; 295B must not be interpreted as the complete checkpoint including MTP. Proposed backbone scope makes this distinction explicit.

active_parameters_b.note: Publisher nominal active count, used with the reported 295B model/backbone. MTP active parameters are not separately disclosed for Hy3; do not transfer the Hy4 MTP active count.

architecture.note: Causal language-model Transformer with GQA and sparse MoE: 80 backbone layers, first layer dense, 192 routed experts/top-8 plus one shared expert, and one MTP layer.

context_window.note: The checkpoint configuration gives the exact position limit 262144, consistent with the card’s 256K. TokenHub separately advertises 256k and has lower per-direction limits; do not treat its 192k input limit as the model context.

modalities.note: Causal text checkpoint and text-only chat template. TokenHub lists no image/video understanding for Hy3, unlike explicitly multimodal rows.

reasoning.note: Supports optional low/high reasoning and no_think; reasoning is a capability, not compulsory for every request.

tool_call.note: Official template implements function/tool calls and tool responses; TokenHub explicitly supports Function Calling.

description.value: Tencent Hy text-generation MoE model with optional reasoning and tool calling, released as the successor to Hy3 preview.
description.note: Replaces broad task positioning with directly documented architecture, supported capabilities and exact variant relationship.

patch.description: Tencent Hy text-generation MoE model with optional reasoning and tool calling, released as the successor to Hy3 preview.
patch.notes: Tencent reports nominal 295B model/backbone parameters and 21B active parameters; the official card separately lists a 3.8B MTP layer. These are author-reported rounded counts, not an exact complete-checkpoint sum; MTP active parameters are not disclosed. The checkpoint config specifies 262,144 context positions, while TokenHub advertises 256k with separate input/output limits. Hy3 was publicly released on 2026-07-06; the earlier repository creation and later config revision are not release dates.

summary: Confirmed stable Hy3 public release on July 6, 2026. Add author-reported nominal 295B/21B counts with separate 3.8B MTP qualification, MoE architecture, Apache-2.0 license and exact configured 262144 context; confirm text, optional reasoning and tools. Current official card/config and later Hy4 card were checked, and targeted technical-report searches found no separate later Hy3 report to refine these counts. Complete checkpoint learned-parameter total and MTP active count remain unverified; no weight shards were downloaded and no exact parameter count was derived.
